# Establish the Task design once before autonomous slicing begins.
- step:
    id: kickoff
    name: kickoff
- step:
    id: review_kickoff
    name: review-design
    human: true
    repeat:
      from: kickoff

- step:
    id: implement
    name: implement
- compress
- review-slice
- step:
    id: review_concepts
    name: concept-review
- step:
    id: decide
    name: loop-decide
    repeat:
      from: implement
- step:
    id: review_delivery
    name: demo
    human: true
    repeat:
      from: implement
